result.instructions: Tools for DeBounce, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Is jane.doe@example.com a deliverable address, or is it risky or disposable?"; "How many validation credits are left on our DeBounce account?"; "Start a bulk check of https://example.com/leads.csv and tell me when it is done.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes DeBounce data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run debounce_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run debounce_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run debounce_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. debounce_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: debounce_validate_email
tools.title: Validate an email address
tools.description: Validate one email address: deliverable, risky, disposable, role-based, free-provider and catch-all results, plus a suggested fix for typos. Each call spends account credits. Set append to add the full name and avatar (extra credits). DeBounce API: GET /v1/.

email.description: The email address to check, for example name@example.com.

append.description: Add the full name and avatar (extra credits; concurrency limit becomes 2).

tools.name: debounce_check_disposable_email
tools.title: Check for a disposable address
tools.description: Check whether an email address or domain is on DeBounce's real-time list of disposable (throwaway) providers. Free, and needs no API key. DeBounce disposable API: GET /.

email.description: An email address or a domain, for example mailinator.com.

tools.name: debounce_get_balance
tools.title: Get the credit balance
tools.description: Get the number of validation credits left on the DeBounce account. Spends no credits. DeBounce API: GET /v1/balance/.

tools.name: debounce_get_usage
tools.title: Get API usage
tools.description: Get the API call counts for a date range (YY-MM-DD, after 20-08-14). DeBounce API: GET /v1/usage/.

end.description: End date as YY-MM-DD. Must not be later than today.

tools.name: debounce_start_bulk_upload
tools.title: Start a bulk validation job
tools.description: Start a bulk validation of a CSV or TXT list that is public at an https:// URL. It spends credits when DeBounce processes the list, and every call creates a new list, so do not repeat it. Returns a list_id for debounce_get_bulk_status. DeBounce bulk API: GET /v1/upload/ on bulk.debounce.io.

url.description: https:// URL of your CSV or TXT email list. DeBounce fetches it, so the URL must be public.

tools.name: debounce_get_bulk_status
tools.title: Get bulk job status
tools.description: Check a bulk validation job by its list_id: status (processing or completed), percentage and, when complete, the download_link. DeBounce bulk API: GET /v1/status/ on bulk.debounce.io.

prompts.title: Get started with DeBounce
prompts.description: What you can do with DeBounce here, with example requests to try.
